auto_install.title: Auto install
auto_install.description: Install missing parsers when entering the first buffer.

sync_install.title: Sync install
sync_install.description: Install all listed parsers synchronously (blocks startup).

ensure_installed.title: Ensure installed
ensure_installed.description: Parser names to make sure are installed, e.g. "lua", "javascript", "rust". Use "all" for everything.

ignore_install.title: Ignore install
ignore_install.description: Parser names that are never auto-installed.

keymaps.title: Keymaps
keymaps.description: Table such as { init_selection = "<CR>", node_incremental = "<TAB>", scope_incremental = "<S-TAB>", node_decremental = "<BS>" }

textobjects.title: Text objects
textobjects.description: Config for nvim-treesitter-textobjects. Requires that sub-plugin installed.
